Las Vegas Hotels and Casinos
Hold up. You’re going where? In a city filled with diversions and excursions, the first question you need to answer is … where am I staying? Find the Las Vegas hotel, casino or resort that matches you − and your ambitions.
Hotels and Casinos FAQs
					
Where can I find Las Vegas hotel deals? 
On this website! Here, there are various packages, offers and deals for Las Vegas hotels and resorts. Discover what’s available now and check back often, as deals are constantly rotating. Want the latest Las Vegas hotel and resort deals delivered directly to your inbox? Sign up for the Visit Las Vegas newsletter.
					
How close are Las Vegas hotels to Harry Reid International Airport? 
The Las Vegas Strip is only 3.5 miles away from the airport, and Las Vegas resorts offer plenty of airport shuttles. There’s also an abundance of readily available rideshare options. With all the choices for getting to the Las Vegas hotels on the Strip, transportation is a breeze, especially with the ease and walkability of the Strip and Downtown Las Vegas.
					
How many Las Vegas hotels and casinos are there?
Las Vegas is always evolving, with consistent grand openings and constant plans for growth. As the Entertainment Capital of the World and The Greatest Arena on Earth, the number of Las Vegas resorts and hotels continues to grow. Currently, there are nearly 300 hotels and resorts to pick from, which comes to more than 151,000 rooms in total.
					
What Las Vegas hotels and resorts are family friendly?
All the Las Vegas hotels and resorts are family-friendly, and there are plenty of things to do with your kids in Las Vegas! Bring your whole family to enjoy the family-fun attractions and choose from Las Vegas kid-friendly resort and hotel options, listed out here.
					
Will I need a rental car while I’m in Las Vegas? 
If you plan to stay near the Las Vegas Strip or in Downtown Las Vegas, renting a car is not necessary. Instead, you can take advantage of the various transportation options the destination offers, such as the Las Vegas Monorail and the Vegas Loop at the Las Vegas Convention Center, as well as the walkability of the Las Vegas Strip and the popularity of ridesharing.
					
What Las Vegas hotels are best for sports fans?
The majority of Las Vegas sports venues are located along the Strip, making any hotel on the Las Vegas Strip a great choice. For a close proximity to Allegiant stadium check out these hotels. Additionally, various hotels and resorts will offer exclusive sports packages on or near game day, so be sure to purchase a package if it’s something you’d enjoy. Almost all the Las Vegas resorts offer incredible dining options too, including either their own sports bar or one nearby for you to be in good company as you watch the game! Check out upcoming sporting events in Las Vegas.
